title: add-long-tail-anomaly-guard-and-contextual-log-joins-for-cost-triage
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: On several recent incidents we saw SLO/alert traffic driven by long-tail, low-frequency token-cost spikes that were hard to triage because traces lacked token-range and KV cache context and alerts fired on noisy percentiles. This PR introduces a lightweight anomaly guard that suppresses transient token-cost spikes for alerting and a contextual log-join helper that enriches logs with token-range, KV cache hit/miss, model-variant, and routing-tier to speed triage.

What this changes (high level):
- Anomaly Guard: per-route and per-tenant rolling-median + MAD detector (configurable windows) that optionally gates alert evaluation. Exposes thresholds and a 'grace' counter so short bursts won't trigger paging. Integrates with existing SLO pipeline so historical baseline is preserved for dashboards.
- Contextual Log Joins: new structured_log_enricher middleware that attaches token_range (start_token:end_token), kv_cache_hit boolean, model_variant, route_tag, and request_shard to request logs and emits a correlation key (cost_cid) that can be used to join traces, spans, and log lines in the observability backend.
- Dashboard: 'LongTail Cost Investigator' panel added to the ops dashboard with a heatmap of token-range cost density, anomaly guard suppressed events, and a quick-link to sample traces filtered by cost_cid.
- Alerts: small alert rule adjustments to use anomaly guard state for paging (pages only when guard indicates persistent deviation). Added feature-flag to enable gradual rollout per environment.
- Tests & tooling: unit tests for guard logic, integration tests exercising log enrichment with local trace joiner, and a small synthetic load job to validate guard behaviour under bursty token distributions.

Checklist:
- [x] Implement rolling MAD-based anomaly guard logic
- [x] Expose guard config via observability-config and default it off for prod
- [x] Add structured_log_enricher middleware and documentation
- [x] Add dashboard panels and alerts with runbook links
- [x] Add unit + integration tests and a synthetic load job
- [x] Feature-flag rollout (staged on beta -> staging -> prod)

Testing & validation:
- Ran synthetic load on perf-canary that generates long-tail token costs; guard suppressed ~92% of transient spikes while still paging on sustained deviations (>=4 windows).
- CI: unit/integration tests passed locally and in pipeline after the second CI rerun.
- Observability verification: dashboards rendered expected heatmaps in staging; sample traces linked successfully via cost_cid join key.

Deployment notes:
- Default config is disabled in production. Enable via observability-config feature flag per environment.
- The guard maintains a small in-memory rolling window per-route; memory usage measured at ~12MB per 1000 active routes and is bounded by a configurable route cap.
- Rollout plan: enable for beta nightlies (now), staging 48h, prod after 7d of stable metrics.

Related: Linear ENG-2419, ENG-2895. Support ticket SUP-4123 reproduced the incident that motivated this work.
